claims.statement: Persistence preferences select tmux, zellij, zmx or herdr and an ask/createManaged/plainShell policy; remote references bind backend, Host, endpoint, username and optional ownership token, excluding presentation metadata from identity.

Only explicit close ends managed sessions; the close coordinator deduplicates identities, fences stale attempts and treats termination failure as best-effort disconnect rather than confirmed remote termination.
Restored resumable transports skip startup preparation; fresh Mosh and ET startup encode the same PTY command through protocol-specific argument or input forms.
Mobile restoration snapshots are versioned and keyed by native session ID; invalid loaded data fences future writes, while legacy workspace/recently-closed keys are retired.
